name: PhishTank
tagline: Community phishing URL verification feed for mail and browser protection
description: PhishTank is a collaborative clearing house for phishing URL verification. Developers can check URLs against a community-maintained phishing database and consume data feeds for mail and browser protection.

auth.details: Optional API key via application parameter; higher rate limits with registered key from free signup at phishtank.com

use_cases: check if a URL is a known phishing site
download phishing URL data feeds for bulk screening
verify reported phishing URLs before blocking
integrate phishing checks into email/browser security
